$comment: CFWU ovarian mass rules file. Every clinical rule the engine applies lives here. sourceStatus: 'protocol' = transcribed from docs/protocol-source.pdf; 'spec' = from docs/spec-source.pdf; 'external-unverified' = NOT in the CFWU protocol, transcribed from the cited publication and requiring clinician verification before sign-off.

protocol.title: Ovarian Mass Ultrasound: Guideline Review & Scanning and Reporting Protocol

signOff.notForClinicalUseBanner: DRAFT RULES - NOT SIGNED OFF - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE

menopause.definition: postmenopausal = >=12 months amenorrhoea, or age >=50 after hysterectomy

centreType.note: Record as 'non-oncology centre' unless the patient is scanned in a tertiary gyn-oncology unit.

physiological.description: Follicle or corpus luteum <=3 cm in a premenopausal woman -> O-RADS 1; stop.

benignDescriptors.evaluationOrder: first match in list order is reported

items.text: unilocular, mixed echogenicity with acoustic shadows, premenopausal (dermoid)
any other unilocular cyst with regular walls

benignDescriptors.source: Protocol, E.2; Spec, Clinical logic step 2

classification.benign: one or more B features and no M features
classification.malignant: one or more M features and no B features
classification.inconclusive: both B and M features, or neither

bFeatures.text: Solid components present, largest solid component <7 mm
Smooth multilocular tumour, largest diameter <100 mm

mFeatures.text: Irregular multilocular-solid tumour, largest diameter >=100 mm

simpleRules.source: Feature definitions are NOT written out in the CFWU protocol (it names B1-B5/M1-M5 only). Transcribed from Timmerman D et al., Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2008 (IOTA Simple Rules). Must be checked against IOTA 2026 updated terms (UOG 2026;67:702-724). Spec acceptance tests 4, 5, 6 and 8 are consistent with these definitions.

adnex.note: ADNEX is entered from the IOTA app/online calculator (total risk + 5 subclass probabilities). The ADNEX formula is NOT implemented (Spec: Phase 4 only, after IOTA permission and validation).
adnex.sumToleranceNote: Arithmetic consistency check only (benign + total should equal 100; the four malignant subclasses should sum to total). Raises a warning, never a block.
adnex.source: Spec, Clinical logic step 3 and fallback; Protocol, E.3

orads.combination: Category from ADNEX band or O-RADS descriptors, whichever is higher; both shown.
orads.multiLesion: Each lesion gets its own score; management is driven by the highest.
orads.source: Protocol, E.5, IOTA 2026 mapping and ACR O-RADS US v2022 section; Spec, Clinical logic step 6

items.text: IOTA Simple Rules M feature present - same-day review by the reporting specialist before the patient leaves; gyn-oncology referral for any M feature.
ADNEX total risk >=10% - same-day review by the reporting specialist before the patient leaves; gynaecological oncology pathway.
ADNEX metastatic risk >=10% - recommend search for a GI, breast or other primary, plus CEA and CA19-9.
Ascites (fluid outside the pouch of Douglas) present.
RMI >200 - gynaecological oncology referral threshold used by Cancer Australia / RACGP.

flags.source: Spec, Clinical logic step 7; Protocol, E.6 and 'Additional triggers regardless of category'

rmi.uScoreNote: index = number of U features, capped at 2 (0 -> 0, 1 -> 1, >=2 -> 3)

featureMapping.multilocular: any lesion of IOTA type multilocular or multilocular-solid
featureMapping.solid: any lesion with a solid component or IOTA type solid
featureMapping.bilateral: lesions recorded on both right and left
featureMapping.metastases: upper-abdomen survey shows peritoneal nodules or omental cake

rmi.source: Protocol names RMI-I, the five U features and the >200 threshold. U-score and M-score values are NOT in the protocol: transcribed from Jacobs I et al., BJOG 1990 (RMI-I). The feature mapping from IOTA fields was confirmed by the clinician on 2026-11-07. The U-score and M-score values still need verification.

0.typicalFindings: Lesion not fully assessable (bowel gas, size, poor access)
0.recommendation: Repeat TVUS/TAUS or MRI; state the reason

2.typicalFindings: Modified BD applies; simple, bilocular smooth, or classic benign lesion <10 cm
2.recommendation: Asymptomatic: per O-RADS v2022 classic-lesion table (e.g. none for small simple cysts; rescan in 8-12 weeks for larger haemorrhagic/simple premenopausal cysts; 12-monthly for dermoid/endometrioma not excised)

3.typicalFindings: ADNEX 1-<10%; smooth multilocular, smooth solid with shadowing, unilocular with small solid component
3.recommendation: Gynaecologist review; options: specialist US (if not already Level III), MRI with O-RADS MRI score, or short-interval US for cystic lesions; surgery in a general gynaecology unit if indicated

4.typicalFindings: ADNEX 10-<50%; multilocular-solid, unilocular-solid, solid with smooth contour and colour score 2-3
4.recommendation: Gynaecologist with gyn-oncology consultation, or direct gyn-oncology referral; MRI for characterisation; CA125 +/- CEA/CA19-9 if not done

5.typicalFindings: ADNEX >=50%; >=4 papillary projections, irregular solid, ascites/peritoneal nodules
5.recommendation: Urgent gyn-oncology referral (e.g. Westmead Hospital gynaecological oncology); CT chest/abdomen/pelvis per gyn-onc protocol
5.communication: Phone referrer same day; document time and recipient

management.byMenopauseNote: The protocol management table is not split by menopausal status. Add premenopausal/postmenopausal overrides here (same shape as byCategory) once the protocol owner provides them.

additionalTriggers.M-FEATURE: Any IOTA M feature: gyn-oncology referral regardless of category.
additionalTriggers.ADNEX-METASTATIC: ADNEX metastatic risk >=10%: recommend search for a GI, breast or other primary, plus CEA and CA19-9.

management.followUp: Compare with the prior study, state interval change in size and morphology, re-run the two-step strategy, and stop surveillance when the lesion resolves or after stability per O-RADS v2022 (management to be verified against the current ACR tables before go-live).

acute.text: Suspected torsion, ectopic, TOA/PID: report descriptively, do not assign O-RADS; urgent verbal communication.

specialSituations.pregnancy: Pregnancy: same lexicon; ADNEX is not yet validated in pregnancy - interpret with caution; decidualised endometriomas can mimic malignancy.
specialSituations.highRisk: High-risk patient (BRCA/Lynch): apply the protocol, but lower the threshold for specialist referral; O-RADS management may be modified by clinical risk.
specialSituations.ovariesNotVisualised: Ovaries not visualised: document; transabdominal attempt; state 'ovaries not visualised' rather than 'normal'.
specialSituations.upperAbdomenSurvey: Suspicious lesion (O-RADS >=4 or any M feature): transabdominal survey of the upper abdomen - ascites in Morison's pouch, omental thickening/cake, peritoneal nodules, liver surface, hydronephrosis, pleural effusion.
specialSituations.source: Protocol, G. Special situations and C.6

review.text: O-RADS 3-5 and all inconclusive lesions are reviewed by a Level III examiner (MFM/gynaecological sonologist) before the report is finalised.
